BiblicalUsage: ektenḗs means without ceasing, fervent. In 1 Peter 4:8, the text says "And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves."
TheologicalSignificance: I read ektenḗs plainly — it means without ceasing, fervent, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
